name: AltStore
description: Distribute iOS apps through AltStore, and build animated controller skins and experimental features for Delta.

interface.shortDescription: Distribute iOS apps through AltStore, and build animated controller skins and experimental features for Delta.
interface.longDescription: Create and update AltStore sources using an IPA or ADP, with guidance on hosting. Animate Delta controller skins by mapping artwork into info.json and cutting cap assets. Build or review Delta experimental features against Delta's contribution guidelines.
defaultPrompt: Help me distribute my app on AltStore.
Map the buttons on my Delta controller skin.
Review my Delta experimental feature PR.
